relations.name: contract_clause_excerpt

relations.purpose_independence_test: Clause excerpts are textual evidence spans with stable meaning outside purpose framing.

relations.name: commercial_note_observation
relations.reason: MECHANICAL relation: A discrete factual observation extracted from internal commercial notes. Required by purposes ['B'] but truth conditions do not depend on those purpose frames.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Commercial note observations are grounded factual extracts independent of purpose.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.reason: SEMANTIC relation: Two referents denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved. Required by purposes ['B', 'A', 'C'] but truth conditions do not depend on those purpose frames.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Whether two identifier-form referents denote the same legal counterparty is a reusable identity fact, not an answer to a specific purpose.

relations.name: obligation_clause_presence
relations.reason: SEMANTIC relation: An active-contract obligation kind (exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term) is present in contract text or remains unresolved. Required by purposes ['C'] but truth conditions do not depend on those purpose frames.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Whether a contract establishes exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term is a contractual fact reusable across dependency analyses.

relations.name: acquisition_clause_presence

relations.purpose_independence_test: Clause presence is classified under purpose-A acquisition taxonomy; meaning depends on that analytical frame.

relations.name: legal_name_variant_pair

relations.name: purpose_b_identity_link
relations.reason: DERIVED relation: Purpose B output link with epistemic disposition over required commercially relevant identifier-form pairs. Interpretation depends on purpose ['B'] policy or output schema.
